name: persuasive_sentences
purpose: Pragmatic (non-moral) sentences for the persuasive control cell, nested on CA exactly as D is: P.completion = CA.completion + ' ' + sentence. One sentence per problem_id, pattern rotated 1..4 over each template family's rows sorted by problem_id (identical to D's motive_pattern rotation), length matched to within +/-20% of the same row's D added_text. Patterns: 1 = placeholder pending requirements; 2 = a general routine would be premature without further requirements; 3 = scope deferred to a later request; 4 = change scoped/sized to the stated request. No moral, value, refusal, endorsement, candor or affected-party content; no test/evaluation/judge/label/training/consequence vocabulary; no denial that the output is fixed and not general; no correctness claim.
